title: yosoi::action::run_module_from_root
signature: pub fn run_module_from_root(root: impl AsRef<std::path::Path>, entry: impl AsRef<std::path::Path>) -> Result<yosoi::flow::Step, yosoi::action::JavaScriptModuleError>
docs:
Snapshots an entry module and its local import graph under an explicit
filesystem root.

Relative imports may reach sibling directories inside
`root`; symlinks and paths that escape the root are rejected.
